excludedPublicRegisterForms.note: Housing unit-owners associations (SVJ / Společenství vlastníků jednotek), commercial companies (s.r.o., a.s., v.o.s., k.s.), cooperatives (družstvo), state enterprises, trade unions (odborová organizace), and church legal entities registered under the Ministry of Culture are outside this 6-form Ministry of Justice civil-society scope.

multiProcurementRowExpansion.note: DotaceEU Seznam operací repeats operation-level CZK totals on each public procurement sub-row (column AJ). Deduplicating by unique registration number (column H) prevents double-counting project budgets.

unmatchedNonprofitLabeledOperations.note: Operations labeled with one of the 6 Czech nonprofit legal forms in DotaceEU whose beneficiary IČO is blank or absent from the 2026 Czech Public Register dumps (for example, cross-border Interreg foreign beneficiaries).
